item.title: Sentiment Analysis of YouTube Comments: A Review and a Case Study on Uzbek Minecraft Comments.
item.description:
Shaxriyor Latipov
This paper reviews ten studies (2013–2025) on sentiment analysis of YouTube comments and presents a small case study on 600 comments from a Minecraft channel run by the author, written mostly in Latin-script Uzbek mixed with English and gaming slang. Testing on held-out videos, logistic regression on word and character n-grams reached a macro-F1 of 0.69, while fine-tuned XLM-RoBERTa and multilingual BERT reached 0.40.
